headline: Esab India declares interim dividend of Rs 20 per share
hook: Third payout this year for Esab holders
summary: Esab India announced an interim dividend of Rs 20 per equity share following a board meeting on November 4, 2026. The distribution rewards current shareholders with a direct cash payout. For retail investors holding the stock as of the record date, this translates to tangible income.
whats_next: Announcement of record date for the interim dividend
why_it_matters: Cash payout credited directly to eligible shareholders.
winners_losers: Esab India shareholders gain / none hurt
